  private async send(data: Uint8Array): Promise<void> {

lambdalisue 10日 18:53:52 Slack 
import { assertEquals } from "<https://deno.land/std@0.68.0/testing/asserts.ts>";

import { decodeStream, encode } from "../mod.ts";

Deno.test("Test decodeStream properly handle incomplete data", async () => {
  const reader = new Deno.Buffer(encode("0123456789"));
  const stream = Deno.iter(reader, { bufSize: 8 });
  const result = await consumeAll(decodeStream(stream));
  assertEquals(result, ["0123456789"]);
});

async function consumeAll<T>(it: AsyncIterable<T>): Promise<T[]> {
  const result = [];
  for await (const item of it) {
    result.push(item);
  }
  return result;
}

1.　非同期なソース構築

main(({ vim, denops }) => {

[[ダウンロード: たぶん最小構成？(プレーンテキスト)]] 
syntax enable
filetype plugin indent on

lua <<EOF
local execute = vim.api.nvim_command
local fn = vim.fn
local install_path = fn.stdpath('data')..'/site/pack/packer/opt/packer.nvim'

if fn.empty(fn.glob(install_path)) > 0 then
  execute('!git clone https://github.com/wbthomason/packer.nvim '..install_path)
end

vim.cmd [[packadd packer.nvim]]

return require('packer').startup(function()
  use {'wbthomason/packer.nvim', opt = true}
  use {'vim-denops/denops.vim'}
  use {'lambdalisue/reword.vim',
    event = "VimEnter",
  }
end)
EOF

[[ダウンロード: dein-and-denops.vim(プレーンテキスト)]] 
if &compatible
  set nocompatible " Be iMproved
endif

const s:dein_dir = expand('~/dein')

" install dein if not found " {{{
if &runtimepath !~# 'dein.vim'
  " git clone
  const s:dein_repo_dir = s:dein_dir . '/repos/github.com/Shougo/dein.vim'
  if !isdirectory(s:dein_repo_dir)
    call system('git clone https://github.com/Shougo/dein.vim.git ' . shellescape(s:dein_repo_dir))
  endif
  " Required:
  " Add the dein installation directory into runtimepath
  exe 'set runtimepath+=' . expand(s:dein_repo_dir)
endif
" }}}

if dein#load_state(s:dein_dir)
  " Required:
  call dein#begin(s:dein_dir)
  call dein#add(expand(s:dein_repo_dir))
  if !has('nvim')
    call dein#add('roxma/nvim-yarp')
    call dein#add('roxma/vim-hug-neovim-rpc')
  endif
  call dein#add('vim-denops/denops.vim')
  call dein#config('denops.vim', {
	\ 'lazy' : 1, 'on_event' : 'VimEnter',
	\ })
  call dein#add('vim-denops/denops-helloworld.vim')

  " auto delete unused plugins
  call map(dein#check_clean(), "delete(v:val, 'rf')")
  " Required:
  call dein#end()   
  call dein#save_state() 
else
  finish
endif

" Required:
filetype plugin indent on
syntax enable

if dein#check_install()
 call dein#install()
endif
